The Expression Atlas experiments GeneFox's Reference › Expression Atlas picker offers: its three curated...

gf_reference_expression_atlas_catalog.Rd

The Expression Atlas experiments GeneFox's Reference › Expression Atlas picker offers: its three curated baseline experiments, then every human baseline experiment in the live Atlas catalog, sorted by description (when the catalog cannot be reached, only the three curated ones, as on the screen, with the failure in catalogue_failure). Optional search (accession or description text) and limit. Use an accession with reference_expression_atlas. Latency: 2-10 s cold, cached for an hour.

Usage

gf_reference_expression_atlas_catalog(
    session,
    `limit` = NULL,
    `search` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

limit

(integer, optional; default 100; range 1..500) How many experiments to list. NULL omits it.

search

(string, optional) Keep experiments whose accession or description contains this text (case-insensitive). NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the reference_expression_atlas_catalog tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/reference-expression-atlas-catalog-result-v1.schema.json.

See also

gf_scientific_tools, gf_tools, gf_call
